name: Hook, Line, and Sinker cuts Flesh Hook and Chainwhip's cooldown by 5 sec (#1368)
contract: Hook, Line, and Sinker 680991 reads 'Reduces the cooldown of Flesh Hook and Chainwhip by $/1000;s1 sec.' (installed moa_description: '-5 sec'). Its sole effect is native aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -5001 with DieSides 1 -> resolved -5000 ms, verified via csv.DictReader against /home/fab/CoaServer/reference/snapshots/ascension-data/tables/spell.csv.gz. Its classmask [524288, 0, 1] intersects both named abilities' own family flags on different words: Chainwhip (spell_family_id 23, family_flags word0 bit19 = 524288, e.g. rank 8 503365) on word0, and Flesh Hook (family_flags word0 bit3 = 8, word2 bit0 = 1, e.g. rank 4 501490) on word2 -- a per-word AND match is sufficient for AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod's classmask check. The level-60 Knight of Xoroth owns Flesh Hook rank 501490 (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h:691) and Chainwhip rank 503365 (:713). Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219) is the native consumer: for SPELLMOD_FLAT it accumulates totalflat and applies it directly, so a 10000ms base becomes 5000ms. The harness's 'spell_modifier' metric calls this exact native path directly.

CONTRACT: Flesh Hook's cooldown drops by 5000 ms (word2 bit0 classmask overlap)
CONTRACT: Chainwhip's cooldown drops by 5000 ms (word0 bit19 classmask overlap)
